facts.business: Croissance Limited (formerly Swagruha Infrastructure Limited) is an Indian listed company.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) loans/advances of Rs 719.85 lakhs, trade receivables of Rs 381.30 lakhs, supplier advances of Rs 119.50 lakhs outstanding >2-3 years without confirmation or ECL provision; (b) trade payables of Rs 217.96 lakhs outstanding >3 years and customer advances of Rs 486.00 lakhs unadjusted >2 years, MSME status unascertained, interest liability not provided; (c) unbilled revenue of Rs 52.80 lakhs and other income of Rs 20.22 lakhs without adequate supporting documentation.

key_risks: Significant balances (loans, advances, receivables, payables) outstanding for 2-3 years without confirmation
No provision for expected credit loss or impairment on long-outstanding assets
MSME vendor status unascertained and related interest liability not provided
Revenue recognition for unbilled revenue and other income lacks adequate supporting documentation
